name: Transfer 39
definition: Parameters applied to the settlement of a security transfer.

TransferReference.name: Transfer Reference
TransferReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the transfer instruction, as assigned by the instructing party.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of the transfer. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the transfer as assigned by the underlying client.

CounterpartyReference.name: Counterparty Reference
CounterpartyReference.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transfer allocated by the counterparty.

BusinessFlowType.name: Business Flow Type
BusinessFlowType.definition: Identifies the business process in which the actors are involved. This is important to trigger the right business process, according to the market business model, which may require matching instructions in a CSD environment (double leg process) or not (single leg process).

RequestedTransferDate.name: Requested Transfer Date
RequestedTransferDate.definition: Date for which the instructing party requests the transfer.

RequestedSettlementDate.name: Requested Settlement Date
RequestedSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be exchanged at the International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) or Central Securities Depository (CSD).

TransferOrderDateForm.name: Transfer Order Date Form
TransferOrderDateForm.definition: Date on which the investor signed the transfer order form.

HoldingsPlanType.name: Holdings Plan Type
HoldingsPlanType.definition: Specifies information about investment plans included in the holding.

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Information related to the financial instrument to be transferred.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Total quantity of securities to be transferred, expressed as a number of units or a percentage rate.

UnitsDetails.name: Units Details
UnitsDetails.definition: Breakdown of units to be transferred.

Rounding.name: Rounding
Rounding.definition: Rounding direction applied to nearest unit.

OriginalCost.name: Original Cost
OriginalCost.definition: Original amount paid for the asset at the point of purchase. May also be known as the book cost.

AveragePrice.name: Average Price
AveragePrice.definition: Value of the security, as booked in the account. Book value is often different from the current market value of the security.

TransferCurrency.name: Transfer Currency
TransferCurrency.definition: Currency to be used to transfer the holdings. Some transfer agents register holdings grouped by currency in addition to using the ISIN for multi-currency fund shares.

OwnAccountTransferIndicator.name: Own Account Transfer Indicator
OwnAccountTransferIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the transfer results in a change of beneficial owner.

NonStandardSettlementInformation.name: Non Standard Settlement Information
NonStandardSettlementInformation.definition: Additional specific settlement information for the fund.

TransferExpensesPaymentType.name: Transfer Expenses Payment Type
TransferExpensesPaymentType.definition: Specifies how the payment of fees and taxes as a result of the transfer is covered, that is, whether by cash or the redemption of units.

TotalUnitsNumberRule.definition: Quantity/TotalUnitsNumber must be the sum of all occurrences of UnitsDetails/UnitsNumber when UnitsDetails is present.
